01111111  unsigned 127, signed 127
+ 00000001  unsigned   1, signed   1
----------
  10000000  unsigned 128, signed -128

C=0: no ninth bit; unsigned 128 fits
V=1: signed mathematical 128 does not fit [-128,127]
N=1: result high bit is set
Z=0: result is nonzero

11111111  unsigned 255, signed -1
+ 00000001  unsigned   1, signed  1
----------
1 00000000

C=1: unsigned mathematical 256 needs a ninth bit
V=0: signed mathematical result is valid zero
N=0: low result high bit is clear
Z=1: low result byte is zero

field width w=2, offset s=4
low mask L=03; positioned mask M=30
eight-bit NOT(M)=CF
clear: AD & CF = 8D
encode new value: (01 & 03) << 4 = 10
write: 8D | 10 = 9D
read back: (9D >> 4) & 03 = 01
outside field: AD & CF = 9D & CF = 8D

VA                  0x12345ABC
P                   0x1000 = 4096
VPN = VA / P        0x12345
offset = VA % P     0xABC
mapping             VPN 0x12345 -> PFN 0x987
frame start         0x987000
PA = start + offset 0x987ABC

    │

    │
    ▼
C++ TRANSLATION UNIT / MODULE UNIT
    │
    ├── declarations establish names and types
    ├── lookup determines what names mean
    ├── definitions provide complete entities
    ├── ODR determines which definitions may coexist
    │
    ▼
COMPILER
    │
    ├── type checking
    ├── template instantiation
    ├── semantic analysis
    ├── optimization
    ├── code/data generation
    │
    ▼
OBJECT FILES
    │
    ├── machine code
    ├── symbols
    ├── relocation records
    ├── static data
    │
    ▼
LINKER
    │
    ├── resolves symbols
    ├── lays out executable sections
    ├── fixes references/relocations
    │
    ▼
EXECUTABLE / SHARED LIBRARY
    │
    ▼
RUNNING PROCESS
    │
    ├── storage becomes available
    ├── objects begin lifetime in that storage
    ├── names/references/pointers may designate objects
    ├── objects have identities and representations
    ├── class layouts determine member locations
    │
    ▼
OBJECT LIFETIME ENDS
    │
    └── storage may disappear OR may remain/reuse

c:
name: C++20 reference laboratory regression

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "tools/labs/**"
      - "tools/modules/**"
      - "tools/m018/**"
      - ".github/workflows/allmight-cpp20-labs.yml"
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "tools/labs/**"
      - "tools/modules/**"
      - "tools/m018/**"
      - ".github/workflows/allmight-cpp20-labs.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  compile-and-run:
    name: ${{ matrix.name }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: GCC sanitizer checks
            compiler: g++
            flags: "-O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer"
          - name: Clang strict checks
            compiler: clang++
            flags: "-O1"
          - name: GCC release checks
            compiler: g++
            flags: "-O2 -DNDEBUG"

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Compile and execute every standalone lab
        shell: bash
        env:
          CXX: ${{ matrix.compiler }}
          EXTRA_FLAGS: ${{ matrix.flags }}
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          mapfile -t labs < <(find tools/labs -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*_lab.cpp' | sort)
          if (( ${#labs[@]} == 0 )); then
            echo "No C++20 labs found" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/allmight-labs"
          for source in "${labs[@]}"; do
            name="$(basename "${source%.cpp}")"
            echo "::group::${name} ($CXX)"
            "$CXX" -std=c++20 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror \
              -pthread $EXTRA_FLAGS "$source" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/allmight-labs/$name"
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/allmight-labs/$name"
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done

  module-boundary:
    name: GCC modules, header unit, and C ABI
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Build C++20 module graph and execute C/C++ consumers
        shell: bash
        run: bash tools/modules/build_module_lab.sh

  m018-compilation-boundaries:
    name: M018 PIMPL, typed handles, scalar and expression labs
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Build distinct translation units; validate checks in release and sanitizer modes
        run: bash tools/m018/build_m018_lab.sh

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
here="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
build="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

compile_and_run() {
    local compiler="$1"; shift
    local mode="$1"; shift
    "$compiler" -std=c++20 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror \
       "$@" "$here/asset_catalog.cpp" "$here/m018_lab.cpp" \
       -o "$build/m018-$mode"
    "$build/m018-$mode"
}
# Checks use exceptions rather than assert(), including in -DNDEBUG mode.
compile_and_run g++ release -O2 -DNDEBUG
compile_and_run clang++ strict -O1
compile_and_run g++ sanitized -O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer

g++ -std=c++20 -O2 -S "$here/assembly_probe.cpp" -o "$build/gcc.s"
clang++ -std=c++20 -O2 -S "$here/assembly_probe.cpp" -o "$build/clang.s"
grep -q 'allmight_m018_sum3' "$build/gcc.s"
grep -q 'allmight_m018_sum3' "$build/clang.s"
python3 "$here/check_note_examples.py" --compiler clang++
echo "m018: multi-TU PIMPL, GCC/Clang/release/sanitizers/assembly: PASS"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Reproducible GCC C++20 module build: DAG order, partitions, implementation,
# two importers, a C ABI consumer, plus an explicitly compiled header unit.
set -Eeuo pipefail
SOURCE_DIR="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
BUILD_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/allmight-m017-modules.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf -- "$BUILD_DIR"' EXIT
cd "$BUILD_DIR"
CXX="${CXX:-g++}"
CC="${CC:-gcc}"
CPP_FLAGS=(-std=c++20 -fmodules-ts -O1 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -I "$SOURCE_DIR")

# Compiled module interfaces (CMIs) require an acyclic, ordered dependency
# graph. Compile partition BEFORE the primary interface that re-exports it.
"$CXX" "${CPP_FLAGS[@]}" -x c++ -c "$SOURCE_DIR/allmight_asset_query_rules.cppm" -o rules.o
"$CXX" "${CPP_FLAGS[@]}" -x c++ -c "$SOURCE_DIR/allmight_asset_query.cppm" -o interface.o
"$CXX" "${CPP_FLAGS[@]}" -x c++ -c "$SOURCE_DIR/allmight_asset_query_impl.cpp" -o implementation.o
"$CXX" "${CPP_FLAGS[@]}" -x c++ -c "$SOURCE_DIR/asset_query_c_api.cpp" -o c_api.o
"$CXX" "${CPP_FLAGS[@]}" -x c++ -c "$SOURCE_DIR/asset_query_secondary.cpp" -o secondary.o
"$CXX" "${CPP_FLAGS[@]}" -x c++ -c "$SOURCE_DIR/asset_query_module_lab.cpp" -o main_consumer.o
"$CXX" rules.o interface.o implementation.o c_api.o secondary.o main_consumer.o -o module_consumer
./module_consumer

# A plain C11 consumer knows nothing about a C++ module or C++ name mangling.
"$CC" -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -I "$SOURCE_DIR" \
  -c "$SOURCE_DIR/asset_query_c_consumer.c" -o plain_c.o
"$CXX" rules.o interface.o implementation.o c_api.o plain_c.o -o c_consumer
./c_consumer

# A header unit needs its OWN CMI. It is not automatically created by selecting
# -std=c++20; this GCC-specific invocation builds it before the import.
"$CXX" "${CPP_FLAGS[@]}" -x c++-user-header asset_query_interop.hpp
"$CXX" "${CPP_FLAGS[@]}" -x c++ -c "$SOURCE_DIR/asset_query_header_unit_lab.cpp" -o header_consumer.o
"$CXX" rules.o interface.o implementation.o header_consumer.o -o header_consumer
./header_consumer
printf '%s\n' 'build_module_lab.sh: all module and C boundary checks passed'
